description: Ledger moment image (1200x675 PNG): one validated XRP Ledger ledger drawn as one tile per transaction in ledger order, colored by type (payments, DEX offers, trust lines, AMM, NFTs, other), failed transactions hollow, with counts, fees burned, XRP supply, and the ledger hash. Latest validated ledger by default. Useful for posts, reports, and newsletters about network activity. The first call each day returns the real answer without payment. After that, about $0.02 via x402 (USDC on Base, or XRP / RLUSD on the XRP Ledger). A payment watch is paid from the first call. Bad input and ledger outages are never charged.
name: ledger_moment
title: Ledger Moment
